release_notes: Adds an interactive sidebar calendar workspace and a persistent post editor with live platform previews, recoverable working copies, per-account variants, and separate AI edit proposals. Calendar and editor selections can be shared with chat. Publishing preferences now include timezone, calendar view, and default destinations. Onboarding guides users to connect a social account and save their first draft. Existing MCP preview, calendar, and posting tools remain available.
